    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "df['Genre'] = df['Genre'].map({'Male': 0, 'Female': 1})\n",
        "\n",
        "print(df.head())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "xcCUv0nxYVXJ",
        "outputId": "53252c92-22b6-49eb-ecf4-de0d2acd54f9"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "   CustomerID  Genre  Age  Annual Income (k$)  Spending Score (1-100)\n",
            "0           1      0   19                  15                      39\n",
            "1           2      0   21                  15                      81\n",
            "2           3      1   20                  16                       6\n",
            "3           4      1   23                  16                      77\n",
            "4           5      1   31                  17                      40\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "X = df[['Age', 'Annual Income (k$)', 'Spending Score (1-100)']]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(X.head())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "8w3-siJ0Yden",
        "outputId": "2cf56db8-705e-4bac-ca69-89854e621456"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "   Age  Annual Income (k$)  Spending Score (1-100)\n",
            "0   19                  15                      39\n",
            "1   21                  15                      81\n",
            "2   20                  16                       6\n",
            "3   23                  16                      77\n",
            "4   31                  17                      40\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "\n",
        "scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
        "\n",
        "X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(X_scaled[:5])"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "mce3f4xxYiKy",
        "outputId": "4f5acd6a-972c-43d0-9297-3bfa4d17346f"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "[[-1.42456879 -1.73899919 -0.43480148]\n",
            " [-1.28103541 -1.73899919  1.19570407]\n",
            " [-1.3528021  -1.70082976 -1.71591298]\n",
            " [-1.13750203 -1.70082976  1.04041783]\n",
            " [-0.56336851 -1.66266033 -0.39597992]]\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.cluster import KMeans\n",
        "\n",
        "wcss = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for i in range(1, 11):\n",
        "    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=i, random_state=42)\n",
        "    kmeans.fit(X_scaled)\n",
        "    wcss.append(kmeans.inertia_)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(wcss)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "-AzCfn3yYo8H",
        "outputId": "7ca891cb-df8f-4683-9261-b553c50b6b4a"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "[599.9999999999999, 389.38618895643714, 295.4562449213557, 205.22514747675913, 169.89149793438568, 134.35277477401493, 121.38935022502866, 113.72723000071333, 102.13623844329251, 92.55027231838784]\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(range(1,11), wcss, marker='o')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Elbow Method\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Number of Clusters\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"WCSS\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 371
        },
        "id": "hNCVLGyGZt3v",
        "outputId": "1a4e3311-159b-4283-c615-a32884cffce3"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 800x500 with 1 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=5, random_state=42)\n",
        "\n",
        "y_kmeans = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled)\n",
        "\n",
        "df['Cluster'] = y_kmeans\n",
        "\n",
        "print(df.head())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "5bsiuZr-aCY6",
        "outputId": "f0a26ea5-8163-467b-8624-33027ef75111"

      "execution_count": null,

        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "   CustomerID  Genre  Age  Annual Income (k$)  Spending Score (1-100)  Cluster\n",
            "0           1      0   19                  15                      39        2\n",
            "1           2      0   21                  15                      81        2\n",
            "2           3      1   20                  16                       6        3\n",
            "3           4      1   23                  16                      77        2\n",
            "4           5      1   31                  17                      40        2\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.scatter(\n",
        "    df['Annual Income (k$)'],\n",

        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Annual Income\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Spending Score\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Customer Segmentation using K-Means\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"
